morning.sourcePrompt:
Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: illustrated background for a cozy couples home game.
Create an ORIGINAL warm, softly hand-drawn 2D living-room interior, landscape 4:3 composition, full bleed, high resolution. Fixed dollhouse cutaway view looking into a room from the open front, slightly elevated camera so we see the tops of furniture and a generous wood floor. Charming clean dark-brown contours, gently rounded shapes, restrained soft painted shading, warm cream and blush pink with sage green, honey wood. Cozy domestic life-game feeling, NOT photorealistic, NOT 3D, NOT pixel art.
Composition: back wall upper half, floor lower half. Big framed window near upper-left center looking onto leafy garden and blue morning sky. On back-left a dusty-rose two-seat sofa with cream and sage cushions. Small potted leafy plants, low wooden bookcase with books on left wall. On right a wooden sideboard with record player, stacked records, small warm table lamp with cream shade, a framed simple botanical picture. One hanging plant. Modest low oval coffee table near bottom-center, two ceramic mugs and an open book. Woven cream oval rug in center lower floor. A pair of slippers by right wall. Clear empty standing spaces on the rug on either side of the coffee table at approximately x40% y72% and x61% y72%, reserved for two game characters to be overlaid later. The table must not obscure those spaces. Cozy considered furnishing with generous breathing room, readable silhouettes.
Morning light pours from the window onto the floor, lamp off. No people, no animals, no text, no lettering, no logos, no UI, no frame around the image, no watermark. The room fills the entire image; floor reaches the bottom edge.
